# TPC-DS-OBT Q74

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH year_total AS (
  SELECT
    obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS year,
    SUM(obt.net_paid) AS year_total,
    's' AS sale_type
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS year,
    SUM(obt.net_paid) AS year_total,
    'w' AS sale_type
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    )
    AND channel = 'web'
  GROUP BY
    obt.bill_customer_c_customer_id,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year
)
SELECT
  t_s_secyear.customer_id,
  t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
  t_s_secyear.customer_last_name
FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear, year_total AS t_s_secyear, year_total AS t_w_firstyear, year_total AS t_w_secyear
WHERE
  t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
  AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
  AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
  AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's'
  AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w'
  AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's'
  AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
  AND t_s_firstyear.year = 1998
  AND t_s_secyear.year = 1998 + 1
  AND t_w_firstyear.year = 1998
  AND t_w_secyear.year = 1998 + 1
  AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND CASE
    WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
    THEN CAST(t_w_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END > CASE
    WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
    THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END
ORDER BY
  3,
  1,
  2
LIMIT 100
```
